title: The Chess Player Appears
next_chapter_hook: In the instant that jet-black chess piece fell into Chen Ji's palm, a violent Heavenly Fate fluctuation erupted from the distant Tianqing Sect—as if something had been awakened.

text.content: Dimensional chaos surged like a tide, swallowing Chen Ji whole. The Founder's voice echoed through the void, each word striking his divine soul. 'Chen Ji, are you prepared to become the new Chess Player?' He felt his consciousness being scrutinized by a higher-dimensional force—the sensation akin to an ant suddenly gazed upon by a giant: insignificant, fragile, yet unyielding.

dialogue.content: 'The page of the Tianji Record within you is merely a fragment lost from the seventh layer of the chessboard.' The Founder's voice carried ancient indifference. 'The Pavilion of Heavenly Secrets contains seven layers, each governing the flow of fate across different dimensions. And the 'Eyes of Heavenly Fate' you speak of? Nothing more than a gatekeeper of the third layer.'

text.content: Chen Ji's heart plummeted. The Eyes of Heavenly Fate—that terrifying consciousness he believed to be the ultimate existence, the可怕存在 that had caused countless seers to fall—in the Founder's words, it was merely a 'gatekeeper'? He felt as though standing before an abyss, its depth far beyond his imagination.

dialogue.content: 'The first layer governs the rise and fall of mortal dynasties. The second controls the fortunes of cultivation sects. The third determines the territorial divisions of sect powers.' The Founder's form slowly materialized within the chaos, yet his features remained obscured. 'As for the Eyes of Heavenly Fate you've been opposing all this time—its duty is merely to prevent low-level seers from crossing boundaries in the隙 between the second and third layers.'

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. All these years, he thought he was playing against Heaven, yet he was merely struggling on the lowest layer of the chessboard? That so-called Heavenly Will, that existence that caused countless talents to fall—was it merely a 'gatekeeper' in a higher-layer game? A chill rose along his spine, mixed with an inexplicable fury.

dialogue.content: 'The fourth layer interferes with the evolution of Heavenly Rules. The fifth rewrites the Dao itself. The sixth—' The Founder's voice paused briefly, '—touches the forbidden origins.' Chen Ji felt the surrounding dimensional chaos suddenly still, as if the universe itself was listening to the words to come. 'And the seventh layer is the domain of the Chess Player. Here, you may reshape all laws, rewrite all fates.'

text.content: 'Reshape all laws? Rewrite all fates?' Chen Ji's voice trembled—not from fear, but from a suppressed desire pushed to its extreme. His father had been imprisoned, his fate unknown; his sister had been taken by the Holy Sect to become a 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key'—was the root of all this predestined on an even higher chessboard? He raised his head, staring directly at the blurred figure: 'Who imprisoned my father?'

dialogue.content: 'An existence of the fifth layer.' The Founder's answer was terse and cold. 'Your father Chen Xuan once touched a forbidden secret he should not have touched. He attempted to uncover the truth of the seventh layer alone, but was viewed as a threat by higher-dimensional beings.' The voice seemed to carry an imperceptible trace of regret. 'If you wish to save him, you must become the Chess Player of the seventh layer. Only the Chess Player can cross dimensional barriers and retrieve exiled souls.'

text.content: Chen Ji felt his heart racing. Becoming a Chess Player—meant being completely drawn into higher-dimensional power games, meant he would transform from a chess piece into part of the chessboard itself. He recalled Mo Xiansheng's profound words: 'With each completed volume, he unseals a page of knowledge.' So everything had been arranged long ago, and he himself was merely a piece in an even grander game.

choice.prompt: The Founder's words echoed through the void—a choice sufficient to change everything. Becoming a Chess Player meant stepping into an unknown abyss; refusal could mean permanently losing the chance to save his father. Chen Ji's fingers trembled slightly, but the cold calculation in his deep eyes never ceased—he was evaluating the true cost of this bargain.

choices.text: Accept the position of Chess Player
choices.description: For his father, for his sister, to shatter this endless chess game, Chen Ji decided to step into the seventh-layer abyss. Even if the path ahead led to eternal damnation, he would personally grasp his own destiny.
choices.visible_cost: Losing freedom as a 'chess piece', being observed by higher-dimensional beings
choices.visible_reward: Gaining the power to reshape laws, the only way to save his father
choices.risk_hint: The price of the Chess Player has never been told by anyone who survived it

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, his jet-black eyes reflecting the light of dimensional chaos: 'I accept.' Three words, brief yet resolute, like a verdict on an irreversible fate. His expression remained calm, but his clenched fists revealed the turbulence within—this was not impulse, but a decision after thorough deliberation.

dialogue.content: 'Excellent.' The Founder's voice seemed to carry an indefinable emotion—was it approval, or something else? 'From this day forward, you are the candidate for Chess Player of the seventh layer. Before you truly master this power, you must still complete the trials of each volume. And the first step—' A jet-black chess piece suddenly materialized in the void, drifting slowly toward Chen Ji, '—accept it.'

choices.text: Demand to see the price first
choices.description: Chen Ji did not immediately agree, but coolly demanded to understand the full price of becoming a Chess Player. He knew too well that no free lunches fall from the sky—the greater the power, the heavier the chains.
choices.visible_cost: Risk offending the Founder, losing this opportunity
choices.visible_reward: Understand the complete truth, avoid falling into a trap
choices.risk_hint: Bargaining with higher-dimensional beings is itself a form of offense

dialogue.content: 'Wait.' Chen Ji raised his hand, stopping the approaching chess piece. 'Before becoming the Chess Player, I need to know the full price.' His voice was terrifyingly calm. 'Every foresight from the Tianji Record consumes Heavenly Fate—does becoming a Chess Player carry a similar cost? If I fail, what happens?'

text.content: The Founder's figure seemed to freeze for an instant, then let out a low laugh: "Interesting. Chen Xuan asked the same question back then." The laughter carried a complex emotion intertwined with nostalgia and mockery. "The price? The price of being a Chess Player is—you will no longer be yourself. All your emotions, memories, and obsessions may become dust in the dimensional turbulence."

In the dimensional turbulence, Chen Ji felt the weight of that pitch-black chess piece—though just energy condensed from the void, it seemed to carry the causality of the entire universe. He remembered his father's last transmission sound before his disappearance: "Little Ji, remember, never trust any free power." But now, did he have a choice?

choice.prompt: The Founder's figure gradually faded in the void, but the black chess piece inscribed with the character "Chen" still floated before Chen Ji. Flowing on its surface were profound patterns, as if whispering some ancient secret. At the same time, Chen Ji felt the violent tremor of the Tianji Record Fragment within his body—it was responding to this chess piece.

choices.text: Reach out to touch the piece
choices.description: Better to take the initiative than wait passively. Chen Ji decided to reach out and touch the chess piece, to see what changes it would bring him—whatever fortune or disaster, what he holds in his own hands is the only truth.
choices.visible_cost: May immediately bear part of the Chess Player's burden
choices.visible_reward: Sense the true nature of the Chess Player's power in advance
choices.risk_hint: The unknown is always the most dangerous

text.content: Chen Ji did not hesitate, raising his right hand toward the chess piece. The moment his fingertips touched it, a cold force surged along his meridians into his Mental Sea—a torrent of countless visions, countless causes and effects, countless intertwined fates. He saw the past and future of the Tianqing Sect, the rise and fall cycles of the three great sects, and even the moment his father was imprisoned.

choices.text: Analyze with the Tianji Record first
choices.description: Before touching anything unknown, first use the Tianji Record's foresight ability to analyze its nature. Though it would consume Heavenly Fate Value, this was a habit Chen Ji had developed over many years—any decision must be based on sufficient information.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 5 points of Heavenly Fate Value
choices.visible_reward: Gain complete information about the chess piece, possibly discovering hidden traps or opportunities
choices.risk_hint: The Tianji Record's analysis may trigger the chess piece's defensive mechanism

text.content: Chen Ji stepped back half a pace, his consciousness sinking into the Tianji Record Fragment within him. A faint Spiritual Light flickered in his eyes, and the world instantly became a network of intertwined causal lines before him. He looked at the chess piece—only to find, surprisingly, that half of its causal lines were blurred, as if obscured by some higher power.

Regardless of what choice Chen Ji made, that pitch-black chess piece still fell into his palm. The moment it touched his hand, the character "Chen" on its surface suddenly glowed, resonating with a certain rune on the Tianji Record Fragment within his body. A strange sensation rushed to his heart—he seemed to perceive the outline of the entire seven-story structure of the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion, like standing on a mountain top overlooking the ranges.

dialogue.content: "The path of a Chess Player has never been smooth." The Founder's voice had become as distant as if coming from the edge of the universe. "Before you truly control this power, everything you cherish may be taken away by higher-dimensional beings. That woman named Su Qingyao, the Demonic Path Saintess, and your sister—they will all become trials on your path." As the words fell, the Founder's figure completely dissipated into the dimensional turbulence.

text.content: Chen Ji tightly gripped the chess piece, his knuckles white from the force. He understood the Founder's warning—from now on, everyone around him would become pieces on the chessboard, sacrifices in higher-dimensional games. And the only thing he could do was be faster, crueler, and more ruthless than all his enemies. A violent Heavenly Fate fluctuation suddenly came from the direction of the Tianqing Sect, as if something had been awakened. Chen Ji's eyes suddenly turned sharp: "Ling Yuan... you truly haven't given up."

The moment that pitch-black chess piece fell into Chen Ji's palm, a violent Heavenly Fate fluctuation suddenly came from the direction of the distant Tianqing Sect—as if something had been awakened. The malice contained in that fluctuation was so familiar that Chen Ji's pupils sharply contracted. It was Ling Yuan. The old Sect Master who ostensibly sheltered him but secretly harbored treacherous intentions. He should have known earlier—the news of becoming a Chess Player wouldn't escape those with ill intentions.

Chen Ji tucked the chess piece into his怀中, turning to look toward the Tianqing Sect. The dimensional turbulence roared behind him, yet could not block the cold flames burning in his eyes. What was Ling Yuan planning? To make a move on Su Qingyao while he was away? Or to directly strike at his arrangements left within the Sect? Whichever it was, he had to return as quickly as possible. At this moment, Chen Ji was painfully aware—the position of Chess Player was not an ending, but the beginning of an even greater game.

The dimensional turbulence began to dissipate, and Chen Ji felt his body being pulled back to the real world by some force. The chess piece in his hand was slightly warm, seemingly guiding toward a certain direction. He took a deep breath, and before his consciousness fully returned, he silently calculated in his heart: Ling Yuan, can you no longer hold back? Very well, let me see what qualification this second-floor guardian has to play against a seventh-floor Chess Player.

When Chen Ji opened his eyes again, he found himself back in the secret cave dwelling at the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain. The chess piece in his怀中 emitted a faint chill, forming a stark contrast with the warmth of the Tianji Record Fragment within his body. He stood up, his gaze sweeping across the meticulously arranged formations in the cave—everything was as before, yet the air was filled with some uneasy aura. He closed his eyes, releasing a thread of divine sense to probe the Sect's movements. After a moment, Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, a fierce killing intent flickering in his pupils: "Su Qingyao is trapped in Ling Yuan's forbidden seal? Such fast action."

Chen Ji did not hesitate in the slightest, his figure turning into a stream of light as he charged toward the depths of the Sect. Ling Yuan's choice to act at this moment was clearly an attempt to eliminate all of his people while he was off-balance. But he made one miscalculation—Chen Ji had never been alone. Su Qingyao was his romantic confidante, and more importantly, the only person who had noticed he was "playing dumb to devour the tiger." Protecting her meant protecting his most important arrangement in this world. The chess piece in his怀中 vibrated slightly, as if responding to his killing intent. A cold smile curved Chen Ji's lips: "Ling Yuan, you're awaiting death."
